# Crafted Consulting

> Denver-based recruiting, fractional HR, and management consulting for small and mid-sized businesses (usually 2 to 250 people). Senior expertise without the overhead. Founded 2019. 100+ teams served, 2,500+ hires made, 500+ leaders supported, 30+ industries. Rated 5.0 on Google from 40+ reviews.

## Services

- [Recruiting](https://www.craftedconsultingusa.com/services.html#recruiting): Targeted sourcing, screening, scheduling, and offer support. Billed hourly, not a percentage of salary. Clients typically have strong candidates to review within about 48 hours, and on average pay about 85% less than a recruiter charging 25 to 30% of first-year salary.
- [Fractional HR](https://www.craftedconsultingusa.com/services.html#fractional-hr): A senior HR partner, part-time. Compliance and policy updates, employee handbooks, corrective action and terminations, unemployment claims, performance management, HR audits, multi-state compliance, onboarding, manager coaching, and payroll and benefits support. Response within 24 hours, usually minutes. Phone, email, or onsite.
- [Management Consulting](https://www.craftedconsultingusa.com/services.html#consulting): Org design and role clarity, leadership development, scorecards and accountability, process improvement, EOS support, and AI training for teams.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://www.craftedconsultingusa.com/pricing.html): Fractional HR starts at $3,000/month and scales with headcount, hours, scope, and onsite needs. Hourly support (recruiting, consulting, HR projects, coaching) starts at $175/hour. No long-term contracts; fractional HR needs 30 days' notice to cancel.
- [FAQ](https://www.craftedconsultingusa.com/pricing.html#faq): Answers on cost, contracts, recruiting, onsite work, EOS, AI training, handbooks, terminations, and unemployment claims.

## Tools

- [HR Risk Check](https://www.craftedconsultingusa.com/hr-risk-check.html): Free 20-question, 3-minute checkup with an instant risk score and top gaps.
- [Savings calculator](https://www.craftedconsultingusa.com/pricing.html#savings): Compares a 30% recruiter fee with typical Crafted recruiting cost.

## About

- [About the team](https://www.craftedconsultingusa.com/about.html): A small Denver team of operators. Clients work directly with the people on the About page. Values: Heart, Hunger, Humility.
